en.ahmedali: These are the verses of the Scripture. Whatsoever is sent down to you from your Lord is the truth; but most men do not believe.
en.ahmedraza: these are verses of the Book; and that which has been sent down upon you from your Lord is true, but most men do not believe. (* Alphabets of the Arabic language – Allah and to whomever He reveals, know their precise meanings.)
en.arberry: Those are the signs of the Book; and that which has been sent down to thee from thy Lord is the truth, but most men do not believe.
en.daryabadi: These are the verses of the Book. And that which is sent down unto thee from thy Lord is the truth, but most of the people believe not.
en.hilali: [These letters are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. These are the Verses of the Book (the Quran), and that which has been revealed unto you (Muhammad SAW) from your Lord is the truth, but most men believe not.
en.itani: These are the signs of the Scripture. What is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most people do not believe.
en.maududi: These are the verses of the Divine Book. Whatever has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and yet most (of your) people do not believe.
en.mubarakpuri: These are the verses of the Book (the Qur'an), and that which has been revealed unto you from your Lord is the truth, but most men believe not.
en.pickthall: These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the Truth, but most of mankind believe not.
en.qarai: These are the signs of the Book. That which has been sent down to you from your Lord is the truth, but most people do not believe [in it].
en.qaribullah: Those are the verses of the Book. That which is sent down to you (Prophet Muhammad) from your Lord is the truth, yet most people do not believe.
en.sahih: These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
en.sarwar: These are the verses of the Book. Whatever is revealed to you from your Lord is the Truth, but most people do not believe.
en.shakir: These are the verses of the Book; and that which is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most people do not believe.
en.transliteration: tilka ayatu alkitabi waallathee onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yuminoona
en.wahiduddin: These are the verses of the Book. What is sent down to you from your Lord is the truth, yet most men do not believe in it.
en.yusufali: These are the signs (or verses) of the Book: that which hath been revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the Truth; but most men believe not.
